strategy.overview: Capture a ball at either Teleport target, then shoot its flashing Dragon's Lair or the Dungeon Level ramp to start two-ball Multiball. Capture both Teleports before making a Lair or Dungeon Level shot to start three-ball play. The upper-left inclined lane and circular ramp also build the timed Dungeon Level multiplier and collect the Bell Tower Million.
strategy.simpleOverview: Capture a ball at a Teleport target, then shoot its flashing Dragon's Lair or the Dungeon Level ramp for two-ball Multiball. Capture balls at both Teleports first for three-ball Multiball. To collect the Bell Tower Million, enter the right Teleport, knock down the three tower targets and rear gate, then shoot the upper-left inclined lane and circular ramp within three seconds.
strategy.summary: Capture one Teleport and shoot its flashing Dragon's Lair or the Dungeon Level ramp for two-ball Multiball; capture both Teleports first for three balls. Open the Bell Tower through the right Teleport and complete it to light the upper-left Million shot.

quickInfo.name: Start two-ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Capture one Teleport ball, then shoot its flashing Dragon's Lair or the Dungeon Level ramp.

quickInfo.name: Start three-ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Capture both Teleport balls, then shoot either Dragon's Lair or the Dungeon Level ramp.

quickInfo.name: Enter Bell Tower
quickInfo.summary: Capture at the right Teleport to lower the Bell Tower ramp.

quickInfo.name: Collect Million
quickInfo.summary: Clear the three tower targets and rear gate, then make the upper-left lane and ramp within three seconds.

steps.text: Hit either Teleport target to capture a ball and flash its corresponding Dragon's Lair plus SUMMON HELP.
Shoot the flashing Dragon's Lair or the Dungeon Level ramp to release the captured ball and start two-ball Multiball.
For three-ball play, capture balls at both Teleport targets before shooting either Dragon's Lair or the Dungeon Level ramp.
Use the cabinet's secondary flipper buttons to open the left or right Magic Save gate when an outlane drain threatens.

alternatives.title: Collect the Bell Tower Million
alternatives.when: Use this after the right Teleport captures a ball and lowers the Bell Tower ramp.

steps.text: Shoot the Bell Tower and knock down its three targets.
Hit the rear gate to light Million.
Shoot the upper-left inclined lane and continue around its circular ramp within three seconds to collect the Million.

alternatives.title: Raise Dungeon Level
alternatives.when: Use this when the upper-left combo is returning safely.

steps.text: Shoot the upper-left inclined lane and circular ramp to raise the temporary playfield multiplier from 2x toward 5x.
Keep scoring during its timed window, then repeat the combo to advance or restart the multiplier.
After the first three-ball Multiball, watch which Teleport capture is requested next; later qualifications require additional capture-and-release cycles.
Use SHIELD and DUST target progress to prepare automatic Magic Saves before committing to the Lair shots.
Complete both active Teleport captures, then choose the safer flashing Dragon's Lair or Dungeon Level ramp to start Multiball.

machineSetup: Confirm Multiball, Magic Save, Dungeon Level timer, Extra Ball, and Special settings before competitive play.
Test both Teleport captures, both Dragon's Lairs, Dungeon Level ramp, Bell Tower lift and targets, rear gate, upper-left combo, Magic Save gates, and cabinet secondary buttons.

cautions.issue: Later three-ball qualifications require more Teleport capture-and-release progress than the first one.
cautions.response: Follow the flashing Teleport and SUMMON HELP lamps; do not assume the opening two-capture route will remain unchanged.
